build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant 1c14b6b0) + this folder's Improved AMP 0.1.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version IA08

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f; no card (starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M; DTBOOT_TURN_PNG after each turn, DTBOOT_STEPS with DTBOOT_PNG_DIR after each key

conditions: Cold boot; eight NO presses from 7003M, 300M apart, close the calibration notices. AMP page: AMP at 11003M (12M), 64 turns of DEC (encoder 2) by -6, 20M apart from 11303M, then 25 turns of HLD (encoder 1) by +6, 20M apart from 12803M (HLD 42). ENV RESET: FUNC + MUTE opens SOUND SETTINGS, four DOWN and YES, two DOWN to ENV RESET, one LEFT from FILTER to AMP. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
